class.name: ChunkWFCEngine2D
class.brief_description: Chunk-based Wave Function Collapse generator with parallel execution.
class.description: A chunked extension of [WFCEngine2D] that divides the generation space into discrete regions ("chunks") and processes them independently, enabling parallelized procedural generation. Instead of operating on a single continuous grid, this engine partitions the domain into fixed-size chunks defined by [member chunk_size]. Each chunk is generated using an internal [WFCEngine2D] solver, while respecting boundary constraints imposed by neighboring chunks. This approach significantly improves scalability and allows large worlds to be generated incrementally or on-demand. The engine uses dependency injection via the [ChunkWFCIO] interface to abstract how chunk data is read and written. This allows integration with external storage systems, streaming pipelines, or custom world representations without modifying the core algorithm. If a chunk fails to converge within the configured attempt limit, it can be retried or reported via signals. Prefer generating chunkc through [generate_range] method as it manages the generation order to avoid conflicts at chunk edges.

method.name: generate_range
method.description: Generates all chunks in the inclusive coordinate range between [param from] and [param to]. Chunks are scheduled for parallel generation, with dependencies automatically resolved based on neighboring constraints. Already generated chunks may be reused depending on the [ChunkWFCIO] implementation.

method.name: get_chunk
method.description: Returns the chunk at the provided coordinates, reading it through [ChunkWFCIO] if it is already available or generating it if not.

method.name: make_generator
method.description:
Creates and initializes a new chunked WFC generator. Any instance created without this method is invalid.
[param chunk_size] defines the dimensions of each chunk. [param weights] specifies the probability weights used for entropy calculation. [param io] provides the data interface used for reading and writing chunk results. [param max_attempts] controls how many times a chunk generation may be retried before being marked as failed. [param seed] initializes the random number generator for deterministic output.
Returns a configured [ChunkWFCEngine2D] instance ready for generation.
